findings.statement: Labour imputation formula = DS(MO) = heures × TAUX HORAIRE CHARGÉ. The loaded hourly cost composes salaire brut + charges patronales + congés payés + primes + indemnités (déplacement/panier).
findings.implication: the engine takes the taux horaire chargé as a SUPPLIED, versioned PARAMETER (not derived); hours × rate = labour cost. If no loaded rate ⇒ COST_NOT_MEASURED. NEVER derive the employer cost from a brut/net salary (directive §4).

findings.statement: Indicative FR loaded hourly rates ~28-48 €/h by qualification (manœuvre/N2-N3/N4).
findings.implication: treated as a NON-BINDING reference only; NOT encoded as a rule, NOT used to fabricate a cost — a real rate must be supplied + validated.

findings.statement: Impute ONLY approved hours × supplied loaded rate as LABOR cost; subcontractor work comes from its INVOICE (SUBCONTRACT), never double-counted as hourly cost.
findings.implication: feeds the anti-double-count rule in workforce-labour-engine + V150 dossier.
